summary: RFC lifecycle: which label closes an RFC that will not be built

options.description: Add a terminal Withdrawn state with a dated reason; Superseded stays for a real successor
Mark every dropped RFC Superseded, the note naming a successor or none
Dropped RFCs keep the Draft label with a dated parked note
Remove dropped RFCs from spec/rfcs and the registry

body: Problem: thirteen RFCs have no code and the lifecycle has no state for an RFC that will not be built except Superseded, which states a successor. Ruling: add a terminal Withdrawn state with a dated reason to the lifecycle gate, registry and docs; Superseded stays for an RFC with a real successor. Whether each RFC is built is asked at the start of its walkthrough. The options are those put to the operator through the decision rubric on 2026-11-18; recorded by the planner.
